segments.sn36.26:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn36.26:1.2: “katamā nu kho, bhante, vedanā, katamo vedanāsamudayo, katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā?
segments.sn36.26:1.4: Ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇan”ti?
segments.sn36.26:1.5: “Tisso imā, bhikkhave, vedanā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
segments.sn36.26:1.10: Phassanirodhā … pe … yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ.
